title.en: Alibaba Releases Qwen3.8-Flash-Next with Hybrid GDN-QSA Architecture
title.zhHans: 阿里巴巴开源 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next，采用 GDN+QSA 混合稀疏注意力架构

searchSummary.en: Alibaba released Qwen3.8-Flash-Next open weights on August 26, 2026, previewing Qwen4 architecture with 125B total parameters, 6B active parameters, and a 262,144-token native context window extendable to 1M with YaRN.
searchSummary.zhHans: 阿里巴巴于 2026 年 8 月 26 日开源 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next，预览 Qwen4 架构：总参数 125B、激活参数 6B、原生上下文 262,144 token，并可借助 YaRN 扩展至 100 万 token。

summary.en: Qwen's repository records the August 26, 2026 release of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next weights. The multimodal MoE model combines Gated DeltaNet, Qwen Sparse Attention, Gated Residual streams, and N-gram embeddings. It has a native 262,144-token context window; one million tokens is an extension configuration, not its native window. Qwen's blog metadata is dated August 3, while the repository and independent coverage identify the later public release.
summary.zhHans: Qwen 的仓库记录 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 权重于 2026 年 8 月 26 日发布。该多模态 MoE 模型结合了 Gated DeltaNet、Qwen Sparse Attention、门控残差流及 N-gram 嵌入。其原生上下文窗口为 262,144 token；100 万 token 属于扩展配置，并非原生窗口。Qwen 博文元数据标为 8 月 3 日，而仓库及独立报道均指向较晚的公开发布时间。

narrative.en: The release is an architectural preview for Qwen4 rather than a completed Qwen4 family launch. Qwen reports lower training cost and strong coding and office-task results relative to named comparison models. The Decoder reports the same figures as Qwen-published benchmarks and notes that benchmark scores can differ from real-world performance. EpochArc therefore treats the architecture, weights, and release date as facts, while keeping performance and cost conclusions attributed to Qwen.
narrative.zhHans: 该发布是面向 Qwen4 的架构预览，而非完整 Qwen4 系列的正式上市。Qwen 报告了更低的训练成本，以及相对于指定比较模型的编程和办公任务成绩。《The Decoder》将这些数字明确为 Qwen 公布的基准，并指出基准分数可能不同于真实世界表现。因此，EpochArc 将架构、权重和发布日期作为事实，而把性能与成本结论归属于 Qwen。

description.en: Publishes an open-weights architectural preview combining sparse-attention and recurrent components for long-context and agentic experimentation.
description.zhHans: 发布结合稀疏注意力与循环组件的开源权重架构预览，可用于长上下文与智能体实验。

description.en: Makes weights and an integration path publicly available for developers evaluating a 6B-active-parameter model.
description.zhHans: 使开发者可公开获得权重与集成路径，以评估一款每 token 激活 6B 参数的模型。

text.en: Qwen released Qwen3.8-Flash-Next open weights on August 26, 2026 with 125B total parameters, 6B active parameters, a 262,144-token native window, and optional YaRN extension to 1M tokens.
text.zhHans: Qwen 于 2026 年 8 月 26 日发布 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 开源权重：总参数 125B、激活参数 6B、原生窗口 262,144 token，并可选用 YaRN 扩展至 100 万 token。

text.en: Qwen reported lower training and inference costs and released integration materials; LMSYS announced day-zero SGLang support.
text.zhHans: Qwen 报告了更低的训练与推理成本并发布集成材料；LMSYS 宣布 SGLang 在发布当日提供支持。

text.en: Published comparative benchmarks and cost claims remain Qwen-reported and require independent, cross-harness validation on real workloads.
text.zhHans: 公开的对比基准与成本主张仍由 Qwen 报告，需要在真实工作负载上进行独立、跨框架验证。

editorial.reviewNotes: Corrected native context from 1M to 262,144 tokens; YaRN extension and August 26 public-release evidence are explicit.

changeLog.summary: Added Qwen3.8-Flash-Next open weights model release.
Completed pre-publication factual-boundary, provenance, and evidence-grade review.
